description: Defining it on a class makes its instances callable with `()`, like functions.
A callable that pre-fills positional and keyword arguments of another callable.
Turns a function into a generic function that picks an implementation from the type of its first argument, following the MRO.
Memoizes a function by its hashable arguments and evicts the least recently used entry when `maxsize` is reached.
Computes a value on first access and stores it in the instance `__dict__`, so later reads skip the method.
